criteria.true: The unit performs one cohesive responsibility: all its steps serve a single purpose its name and docblock state.
criteria.false: There is more than one reason for the unit to change: it mixes business logic, data validation, and side effects.

criteria.true: The code identifiers are greppable: written out in full at every occurrence, never split or dynamically constructed, specific enough that a search hit is a genuine reference.
criteria.false: At least one identifier cannot be found by a single search: split into fragments, renamed at a boundary, or a bare word whose hits are noise.
